s: Din arbit bemotzae shabbat ubo d' seipim: nohagim shemmeacharim tepillat arbit bemotzae shabbat, kede lehosip mechol al haqqodesh. Abal iqqar yetziat hashshabbat hu mishsheat tzet g' kokabim qetannim, sheen anu beqiim bebenonim, umiyyad sheyyatzeu g' kokabim qetannim haya muttar baasiyyat melaka, ella shetztzarik lehamtin ad sheyyihyu g' kokabim omedim retzupim bemaqom echad velo mepuzzarim, shezzehu hashshiur shetztzarik lehosip mechol al haqqodesh bitziat hashshabbat. Abal miyyad shennirim g' kokabim retzupim muttar lehabdil velaasot melaka, ap al pi sheadayin lo hitpallel arbit. Veim hu yom hammeunnan — yamtin ad sheyyetze hassapeq millibbo:

Mi shehu anus shei epshar lo lehabdil al hakkos ballayla, kegon shetztzarik lelek lidbar mitzva veholek mibbeto mibbeod yom ad sop hattechum veyosheb sham ad shechasheka, umiyyad shechasheka holek ledarko — yakol lehitpallel arbit ulehabdil al hakkos bebeto mibbeod yom, ubilbad sheyyehe mippelag hammincha ulemala. Velo yebarek al hanner mibbeod yom, ella yabdil belo ner. Ubaasiyyat melaka asur ad tzet hakkokabim retzupim ap al pi shehibdil. Veken qeriat shema tzarik lachazor veliqrot betzet hakkokabim kesheholek badderek, veeno yotze bemah sheqqara mibbeod yom, ap al pi shebbehabdala yotze yede chobato veeno tzarik lachazor ulehabdil ap im yizdammen lo kos badderek. Veim hu rotzeh yakol lehitpallel tepillat y"ch bilbaddah mibbeod yom belo qeriat shema ubirkoteha, ukeshettechshak lo badderek yiqra qeriat shema bebirkoteha. Veap sheeno somek geulla litpilla — en lachush, hoil umitkavven lidbar mitzva:
Yesh omerim sheap shechakamim hittiru leadam laasot ken — tob leadam lizzaher shello yaaseh ken, mippene shehu dabar hattamuah larabbim:
(Hayu) nohagim lomar "vehu rachum" u"bareku" bemeshek gadol ubaarikut noam, kede lehosip mechol al haqqodesh:
